metadata.title: Refund and cancellation policy · Outvers
metadata.description: Outvers refund policy explained — Flexible, Moderate, Strict presets, refund SLA, vendor-cancelled bookings, and how to request a cashout from your wallet.

calculator.heading: See your exact refund before you book
calculator.description: Enter a booking total, pick the preset, and choose when you would cancel. We run the same refund calculation the money path uses — so the figure here is the figure you would get.
calculator.promptEmpty: Enter an amount and both dates to see your refund.
calculator.promptInvalid: Your cancellation is on or after the start time, so it falls outside the policy window and would open a support dispute rather than an automatic refund.
calculator.walletNoteBody: An eligible refund credits your Refund balance — the cash-returnable bucket of your two-bucket Wallet. You can spend it on a future booking or cash it out to your original payment method (5–7 working days). It is not Outvers credit, which is promotional and spendable on Outvers only.

hero.title: Refund and cancellation policy
hero.description: Every Outvers Experience has one of three named cancellation presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict. The preset is locked when you book and is shown on every Experience card, the checkout page, the confirmation email, and the WhatsApp confirmation. Refund math is a pure function of the preset, your cancellation timestamp, and the booking total. No human review inside the policy window.

examples.heading: Worked examples
examples.flexibleTitle: A short day trip — Rishikesh rafting at 9 AM Saturday
examples.flexibleBody: Cancel by Friday 9 AM → full refund. Cancel Friday 9 AM to Saturday 7 AM → 50% refund. After 7 AM Saturday → no refund.
examples.moderateTitle: A weekend trek starting Saturday 6 AM
examples.moderateBody: Cancel by Wednesday 6 AM → full refund. Cancel Wednesday 6 AM to Friday 6 AM → 50% refund. After Friday 6 AM → no refund.
examples.strictTitle: A multi-day Himalayan trek starting on the 20th
examples.strictBody: Cancel by the 6th → full refund. Cancel between the 6th and the 13th → 50% refund. After the 13th → no refund.

specialCases.heading: Special cases
specialCases.vendorCancelledBody: If a vendor cancels — weather, equipment failure, staffing — you receive a 100% refund regardless of preset. The vendor's response-time SLA score takes a hit.
specialCases.outsideWindowBody: If you cancel after the experience start time, the cancellation opens a dispute. Resolution is at admin discretion; declined by default except in clear vendor-fault cases.
specialCases.customPoliciesBody: A small number of high-altitude expeditions and festival-day experiences have a Custom policy with non-refundable permits or guide deposits. These are admin-approved at listing time and shown in plain language on the Experience page.

refundSla.heading: When you'll see the money
refundSla.body: Eligible refunds credit to your Outvers wallet within 24 hours of an inside-policy cancellation. The wallet balance is spendable on any future booking; you can request a cashout to your original payment method any time — Razorpay round-trips bank transfers in 5–7 working days.

questions.heading: Still have questions?
questions.body: Email {email} or use the in-app chat on any booking — disputes filed inside the policy window are resolved within 48 hours.
